title: Raider lineage-data (versioned: schemaVersion 1 frozen, 2 = ADR-032 additive extension)
description: Data resource of a Raider session lineage run (ADR-027, card LIN-02A; v2 extension ADR-032, card RAI-143). The generated lineage program carries no inline data: every node payload lives in `data` and is referenced by `dataRef`. schemaVersion 1 is frozen and pinned: a v1 document is exactly the historical shape (the if/then below forbids v2-only fields on v1). schemaVersion 2 adds OPTIONAL provenance, phaseData.recovery and delegationData.invocationId fields; nothing else changes. Any further shape change is a new schemaVersion, never a silent change.

schemaVersion.description: Wire revision of this document. 1 = frozen LIN-02A revision (v2-only fields forbidden). 2 = ADR-032 additive extension (optional provenance/phaseData.recovery/delegationData.invocationId).

generator.description: Toolchain that produced the run (pinned environment, ADR-027 pinning).

scalaVersion.description: Pinned Scala 3 version of the language policy.

runId.description: Identifier of the recorded run (chat session, headless run or campaign run).

nodes.description: Call-graph nodes. Array order is causality order: a parent must appear before its children (parents-before-children).

data.description: Node-specific payloads keyed by dataRef. Keys must be non-empty strings; every value must match exactly one node-data shape.

provenance.description: Cross-run provenance record (ADR-032): parent run id and native artifact pointers. Optional; absent = no cross-run linkage recorded, never guessed. Forbidden on schemaVersion-1 documents (see the top-level if/then).

then.description: A v1 document is pinned: the ADR-032 provenance field must be absent. (Version coupling of phaseData.recovery and delegationData.invocationId cannot reference the document version in draft-07; it is validator/reducer-checked, per the contract README's split of schema-enforced vs validator-enforced invariants.)

id.description: Unique within the document (invariant checked by the reducer/validator).

parentId.description: Control (tree) edge. null for roots; otherwise a node that appears earlier in `nodes`.

seq.description: Run-scoped monotonically increasing node counter (canonical generators emit 1, 2, 3, ...).

atMs.description: Offset from run start in milliseconds.

inputs.description: Dataflow edges: nodeIds whose outputs this node consumes.

dataRef.description: Key into `data`. Required (non-null) for model_call and tool_call nodes; canonical generators emit it for every node kind.

prompt.description: Full prompt text (ADR-027: prompts are stored whole, in the data resource, not in code).

outcome.description: null = the call had not finished when the artifact was written (unfinished node).

invocationId.description: ADR-032 correlation field (optional): the delegation invocation this child job belongs to. Validator/reducer-checked against schemaVersion (v1 documents must not carry it).

recovery.description: ADR-032 phase recovery metadata (optional): the live re-run isolation policy class of the phase. Validator/reducer-checked against schemaVersion (v1 documents must not carry it).

kind.description: Pointer kind, e.g. work_dir or events.

path.description: Native artifact location (environment-relative; deliberately NOT part of GraphHash, ADR-032 §3).

parentRunId.description: Run id of the parent run; null/absent = root run (never guessed).

artifacts.description: Native artifact pointers of the upstream run.

nodeData.description: The four shapes are mutually exclusive (each requires a distinct key the others forbid), so oneOf acts as an exact discriminator. Which shape applies to a dataRef is fixed by the kind of the node referencing it (invariant checked by the reducer/validator).
